description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Topbar' which represents the top navigation bar in a dashboard UI. It includes UI elements such as theme toggle, user profile menu, and a live status indicator. The component makes use of custom hooks for theme context, authentication, and socket connection, and manages local UI state for menu visibility.

methods.name: Topbar({ onMenu })
methods.description: React functional component rendering the top navigation bar with menu, theme toggle, and user profile actions.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout by closing the menu and invoking the logout function from AuthContext.
